plugins.name: git-cleanup
plugins.description: Audit local branches and worktrees against GitHub PR state, auto-clean safe ones, prompt on the rest.

plugins.name: ridl-lsp
plugins.description: RIDL language server for .ridl schema files.

plugins.name: agent-comms
plugins.description: Two agent sessions (e.g. Claude author + Codex reviewer) autonomously iterate on an artifact through a shared file until they converge or hit an impasse.

plugins.name: codex-review
plugins.description: Run a Codex code review against a GitHub PR (async, in a throwaway worktree), specific files, or the local working tree.

plugins.name: gh-workflow
plugins.description: Authoring GitHub PRs and issues: shared body-composition rules, PR-description and issue-body formats, the gated review pipeline, chained/dependent-PR merge order, and code-review output convention.

plugins.name: go-style
plugins.description: Go style conventions: type design and composition, naming and package-prefix stripping, named returns, error wrapping and translation, unchecked-error marking, hashing/secrets, config-at-startup validation, HTTP-client injection, new(value)/struct-literal init, import aliasing rules, logger naming, test shape, assertion collapsing, parser colocation.

plugins.name: service-skeleton
plugins.description: Go backend service layout: cmd/rpc/data/clients/tests structure, patterns, and anti-patterns.

plugins.name: gh-stack
plugins.description: GitHub-native stacked pull requests via the gh-stack CLI extension — create, sync, navigate, and atomically merge PR stacks.

plugins.name: writing-for-humans
plugins.description: The house standard for writing prose a human reader can genuinely follow: concise means simplify not compress, discursive sentences, show-don't-name with worked examples, and choosing prose/list/table/diagram by the shape of the information. Apply to any human-facing writing.

plugins.name: design-proposal
plugins.description: Structure a decision-ready engineering design proposal: recommendation-first argument, source-authority discipline (facts vs recommendations), the layered design+plan/spec structure, alternatives, and review reconciliation. Delegates prose quality to writing-for-humans.
